body:
A Tech Debt task auto-filed for a completed task with no feature stores `feature: null`, which is correct (`board.new_debt`). But the board stylesheet has `.card:has(.debt){--tab:var(--test)}`; that overrides the card stripe with the purple test color for every Tech Debt card, so a featureless one is purple instead of the gray default. D-114 and Spec 15 §1 say a card's stripe is its feature's color, gray with no feature or one not started.

Remove that override so the stripe follows the feature: the feature's color when the Tech Debt task has one, gray when it does not. Keep the "Tech debt" badge and tooltip; the badge, not the stripe, marks the category.

Add regression coverage in `solace-cli/board`: a featureless Tech Debt card renders with no feature stripe and no `.card:has(.debt)` override; a Tech Debt card with a feature uses that feature's color; both show `class="debt"`. Keep the existing badge test.

Left out: changing how Tech Debt tasks are filed, titled or grouped, and any broader card or palette redesign.
title: board: featureless tech debt cards stay gray
